name: Cowa Robot
summary:
Cowa, also known as COWAROBOT, develops Physical AI systems for urban services. Its portfolio spans city-operation service robots, quadrupeds, autonomous shuttle vehicles and humanoid robots, using different physical forms to address different tasks. The company's public materials describe a broader 'Robo-City' approach to bringing robots into everyday urban operations.

Its emphasis is on automating repetitive or strenuous activities while improving consistency and safety in service delivery. Rather than center the business on one robot, Kuwa connects autonomy and AI with multiple application platforms. Research and commercial operations across Chinese cities support development and deployment of these systems.
